newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche appoints German manager for MGAM - paper.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche appoints German manager for MGAM - paper.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG has appointed a manager of its German fund management unit DWS, Udo Behrenwald, to join the management of Morgan Grenfell Unit Trust Managers Ltd to tighten its control of the British fund manager, Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeiting reported on Monday.
The newspaper said further management changes were likely to be made once it was known who was responsible for the failure of internal controls at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM).
It said Behrenwald would also retain his position at DWS.
Deutsche Bank could not immediately be reached for comment.
Senior Deutsche Bank officials have announced an overhaul of supervision at MGAM after trading in three funds was temporarily halted last week due to "temporary irregularities."

The manager of two of the funds, Peter Young, has been suspended and his personal assets frozen pending a probe into his management of the funds, which held a high proportion of speculative, high-technology stocks. Investors sold off eight percent of the funds worth 1.14 billion stg when trading resumed on Thursday and a further five percent on Friday.
British papers at the weekend named Glynn Owen, MGAM's chief European investment officer, and Keith Percy, chief executive, as those likely to face criticism if failings are exposed.
